summary: US stocks eased on Wednesday 25 Nov before Thanksgiving: the S&P 500 slipped 0.25% to 7,182.78 and the VIX rose to 28.29, still down from 35.9 on 20 Nov, while the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.85%. The Bank of Korea raised its rate to 3.25% on 26 Nov, and the US announced Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners. The Mexican peso weakened to 19.6711 per dollar (+4.0% in a week), while the yen was steady near 159.26. EU gas storage was 68.9% on 22 Nov, and ICSG's November bulletin showed a 222 kt refined copper surplus for January to September. US markets were closed on 26 Nov; oil, gas and metals futures carry older values because no verifiable November closes were found.

climate.headline: From flooded homes to dying cattle, El Nino wreaks havoc across continents as food prices loom
climate.detail: Bolivia declared an emergency with drought affecting 78,000 families and over 75,000 cattle dead; Peru's forest fires killed at least 12; FAO warns of drought risk for southern Africa crops.

climate.headline: Is Europe's Gas Storage Really 75% Full? It Is Lower, and a Record Low for the Date
climate.detail: EU storage was 68.9% on 22 Nov (GIE AGSI+), below the 2011-2025 range every day since 1 Aug; the 2026 peak was 74.96% on 27 Oct. Germany was 57.11% on 17 Nov.

climate.headline: Another drop in Rhine water levels risks even higher barge rates
climate.detail: Germany's waterways authority forecast the Kaub gauge falling to about 5 cm by 9 Nov against a five-year average above 150 cm; standard barges could not pass.

climate.headline: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is 'no ambiguity in the science'
climate.detail: Talks in Antalya closed 22 Nov without the presidency's cover decision; Article 6.2 text only took note of reviews finding 543 inconsistencies. COP32 will be in Addis Ababa.
climate.source: UN News and Carbon Brief, 22 Nov 2026

climate.headline: Climate outlook: strong El Nino underway, forecast to peak as 'very strong'
climate.detail: Bureau of Meteorology expects a peak in November to December, with above-average rainfall across much of Australia and above-average temperatures. WMO's 21 Oct update projects Nino 3.4 near +3.8C.
climate.source: Bureau of Meteorology, outlook of 15 Oct 2026

climate.headline: Monsoon shortfall and strong El Nino risk India's rabi sowing
climate.detail: India's monsoon rainfall finished 12.6% below normal, fourth-lowest since 2001; reservoirs 1% below average, with concern in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan and Karnataka.
